title: Kilo Code
summary: Kilo Code is a command-line coding agent that Jev can pick like Claude Code, Codex, Copilot and Cursor. It edits the project in Development mode and only reads in Planning mode.
usage: Install the kilo command (npm install -g @kilocode/cli) and sign in with kilo auth; then turn it on in Settings › Kilo Code and refresh its models. Auto-approve is always on in Development and off in Planning.
